Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rahul Bharti, Judge
 Order

07.06.2023 The land acquisition exercise which came to be initiated in terms of section 4 (1) of the Land Acquisition Act, Svt. 1990 vide notification no. 14 of 2019 dated 25.07.2019 came to result in passing of award no. SDM/JMU/S/LA/Ring Road/Sarore/4121-23 dated 25.01.2020 by the Collector Land Acquisition, Sub Divisional Magistrate, Jammu South.
In terms of this acquisition award land measuring 71.9 kanals situated in village Sarore for the purpose of Ring Road at village Sarore came to be purportedly acquired.

The grievance of the petitioners is that after coming into operation of the J&K Reorganization Act,
2019, the land acquisition exercise initiated under section 4 notification of J&K Land Acquisition Act, Svt., 1990 was supposed to have been carried forward under the corresponding provision of central law which got extended and applicable to the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir in terms of Jammu and Kashmir Reorganization (Removal of Difficulties) Order, 2019.

entities.text: Jammu and Kashmir Reorganization (Removal of Difficulties) Order, 2019
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: By this reference, the learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the award in the particular case ought to have been passed by reference to provisions of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that even compensation amount has not been paid to the petitioners for the land acquired which vitiates the entire land acquisition exercise undertaken at the end of the respondents.
Prima facie case is made out.

Mrs. Monika Kohli, learned Sr. AAG accepts notice on behalf of the respondent nos. 1 to 3 and Mr.
Sunny Mahajan, learned counsel on behalf of the respondent no. 4.

Mr. Sunny Mahajan, learned counsel for the respondent no. 4- National Highway Authority of India is directed to file status with respect to the payment of the award money from the respondent no. 4's end to the Collector Land Acquisition, SDM, Jammu South for its disbursement to the land owners held entitled to payment of the compensation as per the award.
